description: Adds something the venue rents by the night: a room, apartment, home, caravan, glamping tent or pitch. For several identical ones (e.g. 20 pitches) create one unit and set identical_units. Guests can see and book it straight away unless shown_to_guests or takes_bookings is false. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

amenities.description: Unit amenity keys (the unit_amenities list of this venue’s stay options), e.g. ["wifi","ac","kitchen"].

beds.description: How many beds of each kind, e.g. {"double":1,"single":2}. Kinds: double, single, sofa, bunk.

description.description: Free text for guests (up to 600 characters).

identical_units.description: How many identical ones exist, e.g. 20 tent and camper pitches. Default 1.

name.description: Name guests see, e.g. "Sea-view studio" or "Tent or camper pitch".

price_per_night_eur.description: Base price per night in euro (seasons can override it).

shown_to_guests.description: False hides the unit from the booking page. Default true.

size_sqm.description: Size in square metres. 0 = not shown.

takes_bookings.description: False keeps the unit visible to guests but they cannot book it (e.g. not ready yet); its nights are closed on connected channels too. The venue can still add bookings itself. Default true.

name: create_unit
title: Add a unit
